files.name: AirBattle_online.swf
files.description: Air Battle local co-op for Ruffle Together: 1-4 balloon boats in one game, each on their own keys (P1 arrows+Z+Down/X, P2 W A D+T+S/Y, P3/P4 numpad; --coop-keys air-battle), PLAYERS button on the main menu. No netcode; every player needs this exact file. 1 player is the original game. Replaces the old relay mod (ONLINE CO-OP or F9)

files.name: BadIceCream_coop.swf
files.description: Bad Ice-Cream for Ruffle Together (lockstep online co-op in the ruffle-coop build, 1.0.0 and later): the game with only the fix for levels that would not start outside the web page, and no online mod code. Both players need this exact file.

files.name: BadIceCream_online.swf
files.description: Bad Ice-Cream online co-op for Ruffle Together (lockstep co-op in the ruffle-coop build, 1.0.0 and later): the game with only the fix for levels that would not start outside the web page. The same bytes as BadIceCream_coop.swf; both players need this exact file. Replaces the old relay mod (F9 panel).

files.name: BowMan_online.swf
files.description: Bow Man for Ruffle Together: VS Human online for 2 PCs (--coop-keys bow-man; P1 W/S + Space, P2 I/K + Enter, or each player's own mouse)

files.name: DadNMe_online.swf
files.description: Dad 'n Me with players 2-4 added (local co-op), played online through Ruffle Together 1.0.3.7 (--coop-keys gun-mayhem-2, --coop-players 2-4): every player on their own keys and their own HUD at the top left, enemies go for the nearest player, one shared screen, a knocked-out player gets up again while anyone is standing, a friend who leaves is taken out and the rest play on. No netcode; every player needs this exact file. 1 player is the original game.

files.name: FireboyWatergirlForestTemple_online.swf
files.description: Fireboy & Watergirl in The Forest Temple for Ruffle Together 1.0.3.6 (--coop-keys fireboy-watergirl, 2 players): the game's own co-op, host = Fireboy, friend = Watergirl; only the ad, the online hiscore board and the sponsor links removed, no netcode. Every player needs this exact file.

files.name: gunmayhem2_online.swf
files.description: Gun Mayhem 2 for Ruffle Together (up to 4 players online; the game's own local multiplayer, keys synced by Ruffle Together)

files.name: Intrusion_online.swf
files.description: Intrusion with local co-op for 2-4 soldiers, played online through Ruffle Together 1.0.3.4+ (--coop-keys intrusion; Players 1-4 on the main menu, shared lives, one camera)

files.name: Intrusion2_online.swf
files.description: Intrusion 2 with local co-op for 1-4 soldiers, played online through Ruffle Together 1.0.3.4+ (--coop-keys intrusion-2; PLAYERS button under START, each player on their own keys, P1 aims with the mouse, respawn next to a teammate). No netcode; every player needs this exact file. With 1 player the co-op code is switched off.

files.name: RaftWars_online.swf
files.description: Raft Wars with 1-4 player turn co-op on the brothers' raft, online through Ruffle Together 1.0.3.6+ (--coop-keys gun-mayhem-2; every player aims with their own keys or mouse and can buy in the shop)

files.name: SmileysWar_online.swf
files.description: Smileys War for Ruffle Together (1.0.3.4 and later, --coop-keys smileys-war): 2-4 humans take the bots' places, each on their own keys and own mouse; the game with added local multiplayer, no netcode. Every player needs this exact file.

files.name: StealthAssassin_online.swf

No netcode; every player needs this exact file. 1 player is the original game. Replaces the old relay mod (F9 panel)
